mcq_drop.why: opinion item ('regarded as the final, decisive event')

pyq_bad.why: wrong topic: Quit India in Bihar (Rajendra Prasad's arrest)

patterns: APPSC's core item: Kurnool (Andhra) Circular drafted by Kala Venkata Rao - a direct author question with Andhra-leader distractors.
National QIM facts recur in PSCs: Gandhi held at Aga Khan Palace, Kasturba's samadhi there, CWC at Ahmednagar Fort.
Andhra specifics likely: firings at Tenali/Guntur/Bhimavaram, women activists, CPI's pro-war stance.
App MCQs are AP-tilted and mostly sound; heavier on multi-statement items than the PYQs.
